projects.title: DORA - Digital Order Routing Assistant
projects.description: An AI-driven automation project that accelerates order resolution through intelligent detection, error classification with 100+ pattern-matching rules, smart routing to SAP or Delivery teams, and scalable real-time processing with sub-minute analysis. Features 24/7 monitoring, comprehensive audit trails, and serverless infrastructure.

projects.title: MoodMiles - Trip That Matches Your Vibe
projects.description: A personalized travel planning application that creates mood-based, budget-friendly itineraries with curated experiences. Uses mood-based algorithms to recommend destinations, activities, and experiences aligned with emotional states. Features dynamic real-time itinerary adjustments and data analytics-driven recommendations.
